versions.readme:
# HTTP sample service

BusyBox `httpd` serving one page whose text comes from the `message` parameter.

- Port: container `8080`, published on the `port` parameter.
- Stateless: no volumes; safe to delete and recreate.
- Verified by the Ferry CI driver suite for Docker, Compose and Swarm (single host).

versions.readme:
# NATS JetStream cluster

Three (or 5, 7, 9) `nats:2.10-alpine` members forming one JetStream cluster.
Each member is a stable instance `nats-<index>` with its own `nats-<index>-data` volume.

- Placement: one member per host (`distinctHosts`). Compose puts all members on one
  host for demos only (`allowSingleHost`; not highly available).
- Ports: client `4222`, routes `6222`, monitoring `8222` in the container. Instance N
  publishes `client_port + N`, `cluster_port + N` and `monitor_port + N`, so members never
  collide even when hosts share a network namespace.
- Routes: `files/nats.conf` lists every member with `{{ range .Role "nats" }}`. With the
  Docker driver a member is reached at its bound address and published route port; with
  Compose at its service name and container port.
- Readiness: `/healthz?js-enabled-only=true`, so a member becomes ready before the
  cluster has a meta leader and members on later hosts can still join.
- Drivers: Docker (one host per member) and Compose (single host). Native needs a
  pipeline-built `nats-server` artifact and is not offered by this package.
- No authentication or TLS is configured; keep the ports on a private network or add
  them before exposing the cluster.
- Topology changes (adding or removing members) are not supported yet; change
  parameters or the image only.

versions.readme:
# Nginx HA web

Stateless Nginx web instances (`web-0`, `web-1`, …) behind one or more Nginx load
balancers (`lb-0`, …). Every web instance serves `<message> from <instance>`.

- Roles: `web` (2–10 instances, one per host) and `lb` (1–3 instances, one per host).
  The load balancer's upstream in `files/nginx-lb.conf` lists every web instance with
  `{{ range .Role "web" }}`; an `lb` instance may share a host with a `web` instance.
- Ports: both roles listen on `80` in the container. Web instance N publishes
  `web_port + N`; load balancer instance N publishes `lb_port + N`.
- Addressing: with the Docker driver the balancer reaches web instances at their bound
  address and published port; with Compose at the service name and port `80`.
- Readiness: web `/`, load balancer `/healthz` (answered locally, so a balancer can
  start before its upstreams).
- Drivers: Docker (instances on distinct hosts) and Compose (single host; demo only,
  not highly available). Native is not offered by this package.
- Changing `message` is a parameter upgrade: a new revision replaces every web instance.
